request.style: English, male solo voice, piano, cello, acoustic guitar, soft pad, hopeful, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
This is the record of the genealogy
Jesus Christ the son of David
The son of Abraham stands revealed
From the dust to the throne he is

[Chorus]
I am the Root and the Offspring of David
The bright Morning Star shines for you
Testified to the churches by my angel
Grace extends to the ones who turn back

[Verse]
A warrior poet who fell into sin
Yet God saw his heart and chose him
A young shepherd under the watchful eye
Defeated the giant with faith in God

[Chorus]
I am the Root and the Offspring of David
The bright Morning Star shines for you
Testified to the churches by my angel
Grace extends to the ones who turn back

[Bridge]
His offspring shall sit on the throne forever
The promise fulfilled in the King of kings
From the depths of sorrow to heights of praise
The record remains for all to see

[Outro]
I am the Root and the Offspring of David
The bright Morning Star
